paragraphs: Yitzchak of Kfar Darom. R' Elazar, his son; Sotah 20b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Sotah 20b follows כ:. under the colon convention, with a terminal stop; no named edition is independently checked.
איש כפר דרום means “man of Kfar Darom.” Hyman explicitly calls Elazar his son. The father has no personal title here; the son’s abbreviated title remains R'.
